title: 疲劳、压力与冷热环境
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/153_疲劳、压力与冷热环境.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/153_疲劳、压力与冷热环境/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣揉揉眼睛，又擦擦汗
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot rubs its sleepy eyes, then wipes sweat from its forehead, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第13章第七课：疲劳、压力与冷热环境。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个电量低的电池图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a low battery icon floating beside its head.
shots.narration: 累了、压力大、太热太冷，都会出错。

shots.scene: 深夜实验室，阿杰一个人打哈欠
shots.prompt_en: Late at night in a university laboratory, the young male student works alone at a bench, yawning, a clock showing late hours.
shots.narration: 凌晨两点，阿杰还在赶实验。

shots.scene: 他眼皮打架，拿起试剂瓶看错了
shots.prompt_en: His eyes half closed, he reaches for the wrong reagent bottle on the shelf.
shots.narration: 迷迷糊糊，差点拿错了试剂。

shots.scene: 小研推门进来拦住他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student enters and stops his hand, shaking her head.
shots.narration: 小研正好回来取东西，拦住了他。

shots.scene: 小研指着时钟和门外
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the clock and toward the door, the young male student nodding tiredly.
shots.narration: 小研：太累了，明天再做。

shots.scene: 大脑图标电量下降
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a brain icon with a draining battery and slow gear wheels. No text.
shots.narration: 疲劳时，判断力和反应会下降。

shots.scene: 熬夜的人与醉酒图标对比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person staying up all night next to a dizzy icon, both with the same wobbly reaction arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 熬一个通宵，反应慢得像喝了酒。

shots.scene: 打盹、点头的人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person nodding off with closing eyes and small sleep marks. No text.
shots.narration: 越来越迷糊，直到打盹，这就是疲劳。

shots.scene: 看错刻度、拿错瓶子、漏一步
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a misread scale, a wrong bottle and a skipped step on a checklist, each with a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 看错、拿错、漏步骤，都容易发生。

shots.scene: 前一晚没睡好，举手说出来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tired student raises a hand to tell a supervisor, a calendar moving a hazardous task to tomorrow. No text.
shots.narration: 没睡好就说出来，危险步骤改时间。

shots.scene: 累了开车打叉，停下休息
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sleepy driver crossed out, and a car parked at a rest area with a coffee cup. No text.
shots.narration: 开车做实验都一样，犯困就停下。

shots.scene: 排班表上轮换的格子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank shift schedule with alternating colored blocks and a rotation arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 样品多、时间长，要排好班。

shots.scene: 轮换后出来喝水休息
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker steps out of a lab to drink water and rest while another takes over. No text.
shots.narration: 定时轮换，出来喝水再进去。

shots.scene: 危险实验安排在精神好的时段
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sun icon over a hazardous experiment card and a moon icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 危险实验，别放在疲惫的时候做。

shots.scene: 调整座椅、活动手腕
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person adjusts a lab chair height and stretches the wrists during a break. No text.
shots.narration: 调好座椅，定时活动手腕和肩颈。

shots.scene: 久盯显微镜后看远处歇眼
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person looks away from a microscope toward a distant window to rest the eyes. No text.
shots.narration: 久盯细处，定时停下歇歇眼。

shots.scene: 检修时带足照明，照亮角落
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses a bright headlamp and a work light to inspect a dark corner above a ceiling panel.
shots.narration: 光线暗的地方，带足照明再动手。

shots.scene: 深夜独自做危险实验，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single person doing a hazardous experiment in a dark empty lab at night, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 危险实验，不能一个人做。

shots.scene: 两人一组在实验室
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two students working together in a lab, one watching the other. No text.
shots.narration: 至少两人在场，互相照应。

shots.scene: 夜间实验申请表，老周签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank approval form for a night experiment at his desk.
shots.narration: 夜间、节假日做实验，先报批。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员登记，手机联络
shots.prompt_en: The security officer records a night lab entry in a log while a student keeps a phone ready.
shots.narration: 告诉值班人员，保持联络。

shots.scene: 王老师提醒：以本校规定为准
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank rules folder on a desk.
shots.narration: 具体要求，以本校规定为准。

shots.scene: 压力山大的学生，论文和数据压在肩上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student carrying a heavy stack of papers and charts on the shoulders, a storm cloud overhead. No text.
shots.narration: 科研压力大，也是一种危害。

shots.scene: 压力大时走神，手里液体洒出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a distracted student spills liquid while thinking about a deadline icon. No text.
shots.narration: 压力大容易走神，操作出错。

shots.scene: 担心出事，紧张焦虑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a nervous person in a lab with a racing heart icon and worried thought bubbles. No text.
shots.narration: 担心出事，也会紧张、焦虑。

shots.scene: 工作生活天平失衡，人被拖垮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance scale tipped heavily toward work, a tired person beside it with a low battery. No text.
shots.narration: 长期透支，人会倦怠没热情。

shots.scene: 天平恢复平衡：运动、睡觉、朋友
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balanced scale with icons of exercise, sleep and friends on one side and work on the other. No text.
shots.narration: 睡好、运动、留点自己的时间。

shots.scene: 一个人扛重物打叉，两人一起抬
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one person carrying a huge weight alone crossed out, and two people sharing the load. No text.
shots.narration: 心里难受，别一个人扛。

shots.scene: 阿杰和老周面谈
shots.prompt_en: The young male student talks with the older man in his office, a calm and open conversation.
shots.narration: 和导师、同学说一说。

shots.scene: 学校心理咨询中心的门
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a friendly counseling center door on a campus with a heart and leaf icon. No text.
shots.narration: 需要时，找学校心理咨询中心。

shots.scene: 担心的隐患说出来，一起解决
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worried student points at a loose fitting in a lab, and a supervisor nods with a wrench. No text.
shots.narration: 担心的安全隐患，也说出来。

shots.scene: 小研注意到同伴走神、情绪低落
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student notices a classmate staring blankly at a bench, looking down and exhausted.
shots.narration: 同伴疲惫走神、情绪差，先关心。

shots.scene: 高风险操作暂停，告诉负责人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hazardous task paused with a hand sign, and a message going to a supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 危险操作先缓一缓，告诉老师。

shots.scene: 事故后的学生坐着发抖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student sitting on a bench after an incident, shaking with a worried face. No text.
shots.narration: 经历事故，人会害怕、焦虑。

shots.scene: 王老师陪伴安慰
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sits beside the student, speaking gently and offering a cup of water.
shots.narration: 要及时疏导，有人陪伴。

shots.scene: 转介心理中心
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow from the lab to the campus counseling center, a heart icon. No text.
shots.narration: 学校提供心理援助。

shots.scene: 心和身体两个恢复进度条
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two recovery bars, one for the body and one for a heart, both filling up. No text.
shots.narration: 心里的恢复，和身体一样重要。

shots.scene: 穿全套防护的人连续工作，时钟转了好几圈
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in a full protective suit, respirator and double gloves working for hours, a clock spinning. No text.
shots.narration: 全套防护连续干几小时，会过热。

shots.scene: 头昏、出汗、判断力下降
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the person sweating heavily with a dizzy spiral icon over the head. No text.
shots.narration: 过热让人头昏，判断力下降。

shots.scene: 漏了一步、加错试剂，冒出气体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a skipped checklist step and a wrong reagent added to a flask, gas rising, warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 漏一步、加错试剂，就可能出事。

shots.scene: 在污染区掀面罩擦汗，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person lifting a respirator mask to wipe sweat inside a contaminated room, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别在污染区掀面罩擦汗。

shots.scene: 先离开、按程序脱下再擦汗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person steps out to a clean area, removes protective gear in order, then wipes the face. No text.
shots.narration: 要擦汗，先离开，按程序脱下。

shots.scene: 轮换、补水、休息
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two people rotating shifts, a water bottle and a resting chair. No text.
shots.narration: 长时间穿戴，轮换休息多补水。

shots.scene: 温室和生长室又热又闷
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hot greenhouse and a plant growth room with heat waves and a high thermometer. No text.
shots.narration: 温室、生长室，又热又闷。

shots.scene: 夏天户外采样，烈日
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two students sampling outdoors under a blazing summer sun. No text.
shots.narration: 夏天户外作业，也要防中暑。

shots.scene: 遮阳帽、饮水、避开中午
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sun hat, a water bottle and a clock avoiding the hottest midday hours. No text.
shots.narration: 备好遮阳和饮水，避开最热时段。

shots.scene: 勤喝水，轮换别久待
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person sipping water often and a rotation arrow between two workers. No text.
shots.narration: 勤喝水，轮换休息，别久待。

shots.scene: 头晕乏力、恶心，马上出来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dizzy and nauseous person walking out of a hot room to a shady cool area. No text.
shots.narration: 头晕乏力恶心，马上出来降温。

shots.scene: 移到阴凉处，松开衣服，喝水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper moves the person to shade, loosens the collar, fans and gives water. No text.
shots.narration: 移到阴凉处，松衣、扇风、补水。

shots.scene: 意识不清，拨打120
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person lying in the shade not responding, a helper calling on a phone with an ambulance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 意识不清或高热，立即拨打120。

shots.scene: 冷室里做实验，呼出白气
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works in a cold room with visible breath, shelves of samples around her.
shots.narration: 冷室冷库里做实验，要注意保暖。

shots.scene: 手指冻僵，拿不稳
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: stiff cold fingers fumbling a small tube, a snowflake icon. No text.
shots.narration: 太冷手指僵硬，容易出错受伤。

shots.scene: 穿保暖外套，戴合适手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person putting on a warm jacket and insulated gloves before entering a cold room. No text.
shots.narration: 穿好保暖衣，戴合适的手套。

shots.scene: 分段进出，别一待太久
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock with short segments and a person stepping out of a cold room to warm up. No text.
shots.narration: 分段进出，别一待太久。

shots.scene: 【实拍】冷室门内侧的应急开门把手和按钮（门内侧近景）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the inside of a cold room door showing a large emergency push release handle and a lit alarm button.
shots.narration: 进门前，确认门能从里面打开。

shots.scene: 进冷室前告诉同伴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tells the young male student before entering the cold room, pointing at her watch.
shots.narration: 进去前告诉同伴，按时出来。

shots.scene: 冷室里放干冰、液氮，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dry ice and a liquid nitrogen dewar inside a closed cold room, crossed out, with an oxygen warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 冷室里别放干冰液氮，防缺氧。

shots.scene: 电池充满、排班表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a full battery and a shift schedule with two people. No text.
shots.narration: 累了就停，排好班，不独自冒险。

shots.scene: 心形和对话气泡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heart and two speech bubbles meeting. No text.
shots.narration: 压力说出来，需要时找心理中心。

shots.scene: 太阳和雪花，水杯和外套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sun with a water bottle and a snowflake with a warm jacket. No text.
shots.narration: 高温补水轮换，冷室保暖防困。

shots.scene: 欣欣背着背包、戴遮阳帽挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a backpack and a sun hat, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：野外实习与外出采样安全。
